summary: Stephen F. Teiser is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Sinology, and religious studies. He earned degrees at Oberlin College and Princeton University under Alan Sponberg, Denis Twitchett, and Daniel L. Overmyer, later teaching at Middlebury College and Princeton.

Stephen Fuchs (1908–2000) was an Indology and religious studies scholar who studied under Wilhelm Schmidt and earned a Ph.D. from the University of Vienna. He taught at St. Xavier's College, Mumbai, and was a visiting scholar at the University of San Carlos.

Stephen G. Covell works in Japanology, Buddhist studies, and religious studies. He completed his doctoral studies at Princeton University under Jacqueline I. Stone around 1995–2001 and held a post at Western Michigan University around 2003.
Stephen H. Phillips is a scholar in Indology and philosophy. He held positions in philosophy at the University of Texas at Austin, attested as professor in 1999 and as professor emeritus in 2026.

Stephen Harris is a scholar of Buddhist studies, philosophy, and Indology. He earned his PhD at the University of New Mexico in 2014 and became a University Lecturer in Indian and Comparative Philosophy at Leiden University (attested 2026).

Stephen J. Laumakis is a scholar of philosophy and Buddhist studies who studied under John Kronen, Ramdas Lamb, and George J. Tanabe. He served at the University of St. Thomas as Professor of Philosophy, attested in 2013.

Stephen Jenkins is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies. He studied at Harvard University under mentors including Masatoshi Nagatomi and Charles Hallisey, and served as Professor of Religious Studies at California State Polytechnic University, Humboldt (attested 2010–2013).

Stephen Prothero is a religious studies scholar who studied at Yale University and Harvard University under William R. Hutchison. Around 1996, he joined Boston University, where he became C. Allyn and Elizabeth V. Russell Professor Emeritus of Religion in America.

Stephen R. Bokenkamp is a Sinologist and religious studies scholar educated at UC Berkeley. He taught at Indiana University Bloomington (~1989–2007) and Arizona State University (~2007), and was a visiting fellow at the Australian National University (1999).
Stephen Suen is a scholar of Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD at the University of Hong Kong under the supervision of K. L. Dhammajoti (attested 2009).

Stephen Wootton Bushell (1844–1908) was a Sinology and history scholar. He studied at Guy's Hospital Medical School and the University of London, and held medical posts at Guy's Hospital (1866) and Bethlem Royal Hospital (1867).

Steve Odin is a scholar of philosophy, Japanology, and Buddhist studies who studied at Stony Brook University under Robert Cummings Neville and David A. Dilworth. He became Professor of Philosophy at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa in 1982.

Steven Collins (1950–2018) was a Buddhist studies and religious studies scholar who earned his D.Phil. at Oxford under Richard Gombrich. He held posts at Bristol, Indiana University Bloomington, and the University of Chicago, among others.

Steven E. Lindquist is an Indology and religious studies scholar who earned his PhD from the University of Texas at Austin under Patrick Olivelle, alongside traditional teachers. He held a post at Concordia University.

Steven Heine is a Buddhist studies, Japanology, and religious studies scholar who studied at the University of Pennsylvania, Temple University, and under Shudo Ishii. He taught at Villanova, La Salle, Penn State, and Florida International University.

Steven Lukes is a scholar of philosophy who studied at Oxford. He held academic appointments at Balliol College, Florence, Siena, the European University Institute, the London School of Economics, and New York University.

Steven Weinberger is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He earned his BA at Amherst College and his MA and PhD at the University of Virginia under Jeffrey Hopkins, later holding an affiliation there (attested 2006).
Stewart McFarlane is a scholar of religious studies, Buddhist studies, and Sinology who held an appointment at Lancaster University's Department of Religious Studies (attested 1991 and 2001).

Sthaneshwar Timalsina works in Indology, philosophy, and religious studies. Educated at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University and Martin Luther University of Halle-Wittenberg, he has held posts at Nepal Sanskrit University, San Diego State University, and Stony Brook University.

Stig Wikander (1908–1983) was an Indology and Iranian studies scholar. Educated at Uppsala University under Henrik Samuel Nyberg and at Copenhagen, he held posts at Lund University and served as chair of Sanskrit at Uppsala (1953–1974).
